name: Skater Hop
steps: Stand in an athletic half-squat on one leg with your chest slightly angled forward and your free leg held slightly off the floor behind you.
Push explosively sideways off your standing foot to bound laterally onto your opposite foot while swinging your arms naturally across your body.
Land softly on the opposite foot with a bent knee and hip, sweeping your trailing leg lightly behind you without slamming it down.
Push right back in the opposite direction, continuing to alternate sides smoothly on each hop.
tips: Stick each landing softly with your knee aligned over your toes before bounding back.
Focus on covering crisp lateral distance while keeping your torso controlled and upright.
